engage.name: Engage Support
engage.description: Tank/semi-tank supports that initiate teamfights with hard CC. Create constant kill threat in lane and open fights at favorable timings.
ideal_with: Burst ADCs with high follow-up (MissFortune R, Samira R, Draven, Lucian)
Farm-oriented junglers (Karthus, Master Yi) — engage support compensates lack of jungle initiation
Comps with damage burst mids (Syndra, Veigar, Ahri)
Vs immobile enemy ADCs (KogMaw, Jinx, Twitch)
avoid_with: Self-peel scaling ADCs (Vayne, KogMaw without frontline)
Enemy team with 2+ dive (Zed, Akali, Vi, Camille) — need peel
Allied control mage mid without follow-up (Veigar)

engage_hybrid.name: Engage Hybrid (Roam-focused)
engage_hybrid.description: Engage supports with strong roam potential and assassin-like execute or stealth tools.
ideal_with: Junglers with early ganks (Elise, Lee Sin, Camille)
avoid_with: Tanky enemy comps (Pyke falls off vs full tanks)

enchanter.name: Enchanter Support
enchanter.description: Long-range fragile supports focused on keeping the ADC alive and empowered. Excel at peel against dive and providing buffs.
ideal_with: Hypercarry scaling ADCs (Jinx, KogMaw, Aphelios, Twitch, Vayne)
Enemy team with 2+ dive (Zed, Camille, Vi, Hecarim)
Junglers with engage (Vi, Sejuani, Wukong) — they engage, you peel
Comps with frontline but squishy ADC
avoid_with: Enemy lane bully ADC (Draven with Pyke)
Full poke siege comp (need mage support instead)

poke.name: Poke / Mage Support
poke.description: Traditional mages played as support. Long-range skillshots for poke, zone control, and sustained damage. High skill ceiling.
ideal_with: Poke ADCs (Caitlyn, Jhin, Varus, Ezreal) — poke siege comp
Allied comp WITHOUT AP damage (compensates damage type)
Enemy team with multiple tanks (need scaled damage)
Weak lane phase enemy bot (Soraka, Yuumi to punish)
avoid_with: Scaling ADCs that need peel (KogMaw, Vayne)
Dive-heavy enemy comps — squishy and no peel

catcher.name: Catcher / Pick Support
catcher.description: Hook/throw based supports that create numerical advantages via picks. High skill ceiling. Lane bullies that snowball.
ideal_with: Junglers with early ganks (Elise, Lee Sin)
Comps that need pick potential (vs scaling enemy comp)
avoid_with: Scaling ADCs that need peel (Vayne, KogMaw)
Enemy team with disciplined positioning (multiple tanks frontline)

vs_dive_comp.reason: Need peel and disengage. Engage support is risk-on with no peel. Mage support is squishy.

vs_poke_comp.reason: Need to close distance and force fights. Engage hard breaks the siege pattern.

vs_pick_comp.reason: Need vision control + tools to negate hooks. R disengage / W polymorph counter picks.

vs_scaling_comp.reason: Need to snowball lane and force objectives before they scale. Lane bullies preferred.

vs_tank_heavy_comp.reason: Need scaled magical damage to break tanks. Engage gets stuck in front of immortal frontline.
